rule: A failed public collector request is an acquisition failure only; no horse is assigned a zero-start record. Alternate evidence may recover the record, but provisional code splits or non-official totals remain flagged until independently verified. Subscriber-only numerical ratings are never published in this public audit.
integrityNotes: Point Of Law public record is limited to career/result facts; subscriber-only numerical ratings have been removed from public data.

Recovered means acquisition succeeded; it does not imply every recovered record has completed final independent verification.
